message.content:
I’m sorry I can’t give you the exact spot‑price right now—my training only goes up until early 2025 and I don’t have live market feeds.  

If you’re looking for the most recent U.S. gold prices (e.g., London Bullion Market Association “LBMA” Gold Price), here’s what you can do:

| Where | How |
|-------|-----|
| **Financial news sites** – Bloomberg, Reuters, CNBC, Financial Times | Search their commodities sections; they publish daily updates. |
| **Gold exchange websites** – Kitco.com, GoldPrice.org, Investing.com | These track the LBMA benchmark and show intraday charts. |
| **U.S. Treasury / Federal Reserve releases** | Occasionally include commodity benchmarks in economic reports. |
| **Mobile apps** – eToro, Robinhood, Fidelity | Many brokerage platforms display real‑time metal pricing. |

For an approximate sense, as of my last update (early 2025) the LBMA gold price hovered around $1,900–$2,000 per ounce, but check one of those sources for the precise figure today.
